source_locator: Supplemental Material, Appendix 1, Table A (p. 3), adult column; Table C (p. 5); advisory Table 1, Diet adult column and Notes on implementation: Diet (Circulation 2022;146:e24-e26)
notes: Adult population-percentile bands, MEPA total bands, and all 16 raw screener criteria are recorded. The raw-item ledger is data-raw/reference-adult/aha2022-adult-mepa-items.csv. The population reference is NHANES 2015-2018. The alcohol connector is logically defective in Table C and the original MEPA article; the executable policy records the agreed bounded-positive interpretation rather than presenting it as a verified transcription. Quantiles may be recalibrated, and culturally contextual healthy diets require clinician judgment.

source_locator: Advisory Table 1, Nicotine exposure adult column and Notes on implementation: Nicotine exposure (Circulation 2022;146:e24-e26)
notes: Combustible-smoking/quit-time and current inhaled-NDS base bands plus the 20-point home indoor secondhand-smoke decrement transcribed. The decrement does not apply when the base score is 0. The source does not state a dual-use tie-break.

source_locator: Advisory Table 1, Sleep health adult column and Notes on implementation: Sleep health (Circulation 2022;146:e24-e26)
notes: All adult duration bands transcribed, including separate low- and high-duration 40-point branches. Untreated or undertreated sleep apnea carries a discretionary, not automatic, consideration to subtract 20 points when information is available.
